description: A Layout Editor label option of the schematic-maps plugin (le_labels, or a band's le_band_labels entry) whose value lists tracks. preferences.json names those tracks by block ID; hartlib.track_names.pref_section gives them the name store's names.
1: a list of tracks; 2: a list of lists of tracks.
How the plugin wants each track named: whole (Track S-1) or bare (S-1).
